comment: Worked out by hand (mitcad#463): an L of lines (0,0)-(40,0)-(40,30) bending left, its wall 2 thick outside (to its right, round the outside of the corner, mitred) and 10 high: (2 * 40 + 2 * 30 + 2 * 2) * 10 = 1440; a half circle of radius 10 about (100,0) counter-clockwise from (110,0), its wall 2 thick centred: pi / 2 * (11^2 - 9^2) * 10 = 628.3185; a 40 x 20 outline at (200,0), 1 inside and 2 outside: (44 * 24 - 38 * 18) * 10 = 3720.
